source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.6.3, printed pages 33-34.

blocks.text: Kisi shell mein d orbitals ki khala mein mukhtalif shaklein aur rukh hain. dxy, dxz aur dyz orbitals bil-tarteeb xy, xz aur yz planes mein hain. dx2-y2 orbital ke lobes x aur y mehwaron par hain. dz2 orbital ke z mehwar par do lobes aur xy plane mein ek chhalla (doughnut) hai. Yeh l = 2 ke paanch d orbitals hain. f subshell ke khala mein saat rukh hain, yani saat f orbitals, magar un ki shaklein bohat pecheeda hain.

z par do lobes, xy plane mein chhalle ke saath

blocks.prompt: Theek paanch d orbitals aur saat f orbitals kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: d ke liye l = 2, to m -2 se +2 tak chalta hai: paanch qeematein, paanch rukh, paanch orbitals. f ke liye l = 3, to m -3 se +3 tak: saat qeematein aur saat orbitals.

items: Paanch d orbitals: dxy, dxz, dyz apne planes ke mehwaron ke darmiyan; dx2-y2 x aur y par; dz2 z par chhalle ke saath. Pecheeda shakal ke saat f orbitals.
